source_files.reuse: byte-for-byte; standalone prost build wrapper only
adapted original identities, validation, transactions, phase transitions, exact immutable history, ownership, capacity reservation and cleanup
integration uses the independently adapted original main draft Slot, selected origin-2 pins and consumed_imports proof; this provenance file does not replace the main draft provenance

preserved_rules: Original schema field numbers and canonical Protobuf bytes, SHA-256 identity framing and reserved journal type/prefix/title
Original Pending intent precedes Core stage_blob_retained; bytes and Snapshot retention commit together or roll back together
Ready is audited only after Core validates declared byte length and SHA-256; exact retained-owner retry never reads the replacement source reader
Import operation immutable Pending history binds request, owner and generated asset identity; payload-changing retry is rejected
Historical retries return current phase without rewinding newer staging revisions or resurrecting Retired/Pruned operations
Selected pins resolve only from an active main draft at the expected current generation; imports may finish at a newer generation only if original bytes are already retained
Consumed markers must match exactly one selected origin-2 pin by asset ID, display name, media type, length and digest before any Snapshot release
Retired transition precedes Snapshot release; Pruned transition follows release, with exact historical cleanup binding and safe resume after partial progress
Inactive main drafts retire and prune all remaining unselected Pending/Ready imports; selected draft/event pins independently retain shared physical bytes
Original limits: 256 journal identities, 20 entries per draft, 320 current entries, 64 MiB aggregate declared bytes, 1 MiB journal body, 256 revisions
Pending admission reserves all still-possible Ready/Retired/Pruned transitions so an accepted import cannot exhaust cleanup revision budget
Private staging journals contain no CardRecord attachment references and never create business cards
Verified streaming export goes through Core export_blob_local and compares returned digest and byte length against retained metadata
adaptation_boundaries: Reader/Writer functions receive the caller-owned serialized HostRuntime, monotonic authorization clock and supplied Unix blob clock rather than WorkbenchState/Storage
Development HostRuntime has no production Storage::prepare_write, library lease, protected maintenance, audit seal, platform key or production storage admission; no equivalence is claimed
The unchanged frozen Core owns byte transactions, deduplication, Snapshot retentions, chunk verification, atomic rollback, event references and delayed collection
Current draft Reader delegates to HMOS editor_draft::read for the original main Slot; captured predecessor/parent lineage remains explicitly unsupported by the development adapter
Initial import pin selection uses durable metadata and ownership; this module does not offer an in-memory importer fallback
Ready resolver additionally compares current request/owner/asset ID to immutable original Pending history before selection, a fail-closed tightening for the unsealed development adapter

Effects describe staging/internal transactions only: a committed Pending intent or retention release remains committed if a later Ready/Pruned transition fails; callers inspect current phase before presenting completion
Exact immutable begin/abandon history marks effect committed before current journal readback, so corruption or disconnect after that proof cannot downgrade the original outcome
Core RevisionConflict/UnsupportedVersion/Invalid/Limit are proven not_committed only before any successful phase in this invocation; other uncertain mutation errors remain unknown
Main draft save/discard must use separate staging cleanup effects; cleanup success does not prove an unissued main draft write committed
Streaming writers may receive partial output before a downstream I/O/digest failure; the external URI adapter must publish only a successfully verified temporary output
No production formal-save S1 capture, S2 parent-child handoff, library import/export archive or rich clipboard HTML support is introduced
